_comment: Phase 6.0. Each system's quartermaster sets its own stock + sell_multiplier in systems/*.json; mined ore sells anywhere. Real per-faction buy/sell spreads are a later pass (BACKLOG).

ore.name: Raw Ore
ore.description: Unrefined metal ore, sold by weight. What a mined asteroid leaves behind.

alloy.name: Combine Alloy
alloy.description: Refined structural alloy from Kiln's deep smelters - rationed, stamped, and never sold cheap.

grain.name: Ring Grain
grain.description: Bulk staple grain from Verdance's habitat rings.

water_credits.name: Water Credits
water_credits.description: Transferable claims on Verdance's reclaimed water - light to carry, heavily regulated.

relief_supplies.name: Relief Supplies
relief_supplies.description: Sealed food, filters, and med-packs for people moving through the half-restored lanes.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.description: Hull cuttings, dead electronics, and Relay-era parts pulled off drifting wrecks. The carriers' bread and butter.

archive_copies.name: Archive Copies
archive_copies.description: Sealed record-slates copied from the Vigil's vaults. Carry them level and keep them dry.

hub_parts.name: Hub Parts
hub_parts.description: Machined components the Wardens run out to the Span's dark segments. Nobody quite says what for.

contraband.name: Unlabelled Cargo
contraband.description: Crates with no manifest. Profitable, and a very good way to get a patrol's attention.
